title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Sobre a Nuvia


A Nuvia é a plataforma de AI-Powered Growth para vendas B2B. No ano passado, fechamos uma rodada com NXTP Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures, 16|16 Ventures, LASP Capital e o scout fund da a16z e logo depois adquirimos a Datasaga.ai (consultoria de dados e IA para vendas) para acelerar nossa operação.

Não vendemos promessa, entregamos pipeline. Com isso, nossos clientes têm em média, +35% de conversão e -50% no custo de aquisição de clientes.

Agora estamos expandindo o time que vai escalar isso para centenas de empresas (nacionais e internacionais). Se você quer ajudar construir a máquina de vendas do futuro (e não só operar ferramentas) esse é o seu lugar.


Seu Papel


Como RevOps Specialist ou GTM Engineer, você vai ser o motor de execução das campanhas de outbound dos nossos clientes. Não é sobre fazer spam, é sobre construir sistemas que transformam estratégia em pipeline de forma escalável e replicável.

Você vai operar na interseção de dados, automação e vendas. Se você não sabe o que é um waterfall de enriquecimento, se nunca montou uma sequência multicanal do zero, ou se acha que "automação" é fazer um Zap básico - essa vaga não é pra você.

O que você vai fazer


  • Construir e operar campanhas multicanal (LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp) do zero ao resultado
  • Criar workflows de automação para enriquecimento, scoring, roteamento e sequenciamento de leads
  • Integrar ferramentas via APIs, webhooks e automações (CRM ↔ outbound ↔ enrichment)
  • Analisar performance e otimizar campanhas com base em métricas reais (reply rate, positive reply, meetings booked, pipeline gerado)
  • Garantir higiene de CRM — dados limpos, pipelines organizados, propriedades padronizadas
  • Otimizar prompts de agentes de Outbound para criação de estratégias e copies.
  • Documentar playbooks para escalar a operação sem depender de você


Quem você é hoje


Você é RevOps Analyst, Growth Engineer, Sales Ops ou GTM Ops em uma startup B2B SaaS com outbound estruturado, agência de outbound/lead gen, ou consultoria HubSpot/Salesforce.

Você já montou campanhas que geraram pipeline de verdade — não só volume. Entende o processo comercial e sabe traduzir isso em fluxos técnicos que rodam sozinhos.

Ou: Você era SDR/BDR e migrou para ops porque percebeu que escala vem de sistemas, não de força bruta. Você automatizou seu próprio trabalho antes de mudar de função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência em RevOps, Sales Ops, Growth Ops ou GTM Ops (B2B SaaS ou agência)
  • N8N avançado - workflows de enriquecimento, roteamento, scoring, integrações. Não só triggers básicos.
  • Python básico - scripts de transformação de dados, chamadas de API, manipulação de listas
  • SQL básico - Queries básicas para análise, extração e limpeza de dados. Você não precisa saber fazer tudo, mas se não souber, precisa explicar muito bem a uma IA como fazer.
  • CRM avançado - workflows, custom properties, APIs, integrações, relatórios. Não "já usei". Mas "já construí".
  • Experiência real com outbound - já operou campanhas que geraram reuniões qualificadas, não só disparos em massa


Diferenciais que pesam

  • Experiência com Clay (enrichment, waterfalls, AI personalization), Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist ou outras ferramentas de automação de Outbound.
  • Já integrou CRMs com ferramentas de outbound via API.
  • Conhecimento de APIs de scraping de dados.
  • Certificações HubSpot, RD, Salesforce ou outras.
  • Background em agência de outbound ou consultoria HubSpot.
  • Já desenvolveu aplicações de Hubspot ou outros CRMs.
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


O que você NÃO é

  • SDR que quer "subir de cargo" mas nunca automatizou nada;
  • Marketeiro que só sabe dar aula mas nunca construiu nada que funcione;
  • Dev que nunca viu um pipeline de vendas de perto;
  • Pessoa que precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Remuneração competitiva com variável AGRESSIVÃO.
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Vendas/Automações/AI e todos os assuntos correlatos.
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto ou híbrido (disponibilidade para calls em horário comercial BR)

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)


We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .


About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Sobre a Nuvia


A Nuvia é a plataforma de AI-Powered Growth para vendas B2B. No ano passado, fechamos uma rodada com NXTP Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures, 16|16 Ventures, LASP Capital e o scout fund da a16z e logo depois adquirimos a Datasaga.ai (consultoria de dados e IA para vendas) para acelerar nossa operação.

Não vendemos promessa, entregamos pipeline. Com isso, nossos clientes têm em média, +35% de conversão e -50% no custo de aquisição de clientes.

Agora estamos expandindo o time que vai escalar isso para centenas de empresas (nacionais e internacionais). Se você quer ajudar construir a máquina de vendas do futuro (e não só operar ferramentas) esse é o seu lugar.


Seu Papel


Como RevOps Specialist ou GTM Engineer, você vai ser o motor de execução das campanhas de outbound dos nossos clientes. Não é sobre fazer spam, é sobre construir sistemas que transformam estratégia em pipeline de forma escalável e replicável.

Você vai operar na interseção de dados, automação e vendas. Se você não sabe o que é um waterfall de enriquecimento, se nunca montou uma sequência multicanal do zero, ou se acha que "automação" é fazer um Zap básico - essa vaga não é pra você.

O que você vai fazer


  • Construir e operar campanhas multicanal (LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp) do zero ao resultado
  • Criar workflows de automação para enriquecimento, scoring, roteamento e sequenciamento de leads
  • Integrar ferramentas via APIs, webhooks e automações (CRM ↔ outbound ↔ enrichment)
  • Analisar performance e otimizar campanhas com base em métricas reais (reply rate, positive reply, meetings booked, pipeline gerado)
  • Garantir higiene de CRM — dados limpos, pipelines organizados, propriedades padronizadas
  • Otimizar prompts de agentes de Outbound para criação de estratégias e copies.
  • Documentar playbooks para escalar a operação sem depender de você


Quem você é hoje


Você é RevOps Analyst, Growth Engineer, Sales Ops ou GTM Ops em uma startup B2B SaaS com outbound estruturado, agência de outbound/lead gen, ou consultoria HubSpot/Salesforce.

Você já montou campanhas que geraram pipeline de verdade — não só volume. Entende o processo comercial e sabe traduzir isso em fluxos técnicos que rodam sozinhos.

Ou: Você era SDR/BDR e migrou para ops porque percebeu que escala vem de sistemas, não de força bruta. Você automatizou seu próprio trabalho antes de mudar de função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência em RevOps, Sales Ops, Growth Ops ou GTM Ops (B2B SaaS ou agência)
  • N8N avançado - workflows de enriquecimento, roteamento, scoring, integrações. Não só triggers básicos.
  • Python básico - scripts de transformação de dados, chamadas de API, manipulação de listas
  • SQL básico - Queries básicas para análise, extração e limpeza de dados. Você não precisa saber fazer tudo, mas se não souber, precisa explicar muito bem a uma IA como fazer.
  • CRM avançado - workflows, custom properties, APIs, integrações, relatórios. Não "já usei". Mas "já construí".
  • Experiência real com outbound - já operou campanhas que geraram reuniões qualificadas, não só disparos em massa


Diferenciais que pesam

  • Experiência com Clay (enrichment, waterfalls, AI personalization), Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist ou outras ferramentas de automação de Outbound.
  • Já integrou CRMs com ferramentas de outbound via API.
  • Conhecimento de APIs de scraping de dados.
  • Certificações HubSpot, RD, Salesforce ou outras.
  • Background em agência de outbound ou consultoria HubSpot.
  • Já desenvolveu aplicações de Hubspot ou outros CRMs.
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


O que você NÃO é

  • SDR que quer "subir de cargo" mas nunca automatizou nada;
  • Marketeiro que só sabe dar aula mas nunca construiu nada que funcione;
  • Dev que nunca viu um pipeline de vendas de perto;
  • Pessoa que precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Remuneração competitiva com variável AGRESSIVÃO.
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Vendas/Automações/AI e todos os assuntos correlatos.
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto ou híbrido (disponibilidade para calls em horário comercial BR)

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English

description:
Canopy Life Sciences is a well-respected vendor & partner in the life sciences industry, assisting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients in various functional areas of expertise. Medical Science Liaison – Dermatology - Brazil


This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:


Clinical Trial Support :


  • Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.

Insight Generation and Framework Creation :

Stakeholder Engagement :


  • Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.
  • Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.


Cross-Border Collaboration :


  • Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.
  • Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.


Travel Requirements :


  • Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.


Independent Work :


  • Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.
  • Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.
  • Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.
  • Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.
  • Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.
  • Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.
  • Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.

  • Monday to Friday

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

title: Especialista em implementação
description:
A SMT é uma empresa de serviços profissionais e inteligência especializada em tecnologias que transformam a forma como as organizações se relacionam com seus clientes, colaboradores, comunidades e demais partes interessadas.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar implementações end-to-end para clientes enterprise em múltiplas regiões e indústrias.
  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos com stakeholders multifuncionais das áreas de Privacidade, Jurídico, Segurança, Compliance e TI.
  • Desenhar e configurar soluções, incluindo Privacy Automation, Tech Risk & Compliance e Third-Party Risk Management.
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio (por exemplo, GDPR, LGPD, CCPA) em configurações escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com arquitetos técnicos para coordenar integrações com os sistemas dos clientes.
  • Gerenciar UAT, migração de dados, atividades de go-live e hypercare pós-lançamento.
  • Conduzir treinamentos, produzir documentação e realizar transferência de conhecimento para garantir a autonomia do cliente.
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança, apoiando a estruturação dos programas de privacidade, compliance e risco dos clientes.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua da metodologia, templates e boas práticas da SMT.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de pré-vendas, incluindo calls de discovery, demonstrações de solução e desenvolvimento de propostas.


Requisitos

  • Fluência em português e inglês (escrita e fala).
  • 3+ anos de experiência em consultoria ou serviços profissionais com implementação de software enterprise.
  • 2+ anos de experiência prática com implementações OneTrust (Privacy, Tech Risk & Compliance ou Third-Party Risk).
  • Experiência comprovada em atuação com clientes, gerenciando múltiplos projetos e stakeholders sêniores.
  • Forte conhecimento em frameworks e regulações de privacidade, segurança ou compliance (por exemplo, GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens internacionais de até 40% do tempo (custeadas pela empresa).


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Proficiência profissional em espanhol e/ou italiano.
  • Experiência com clientes multinacionais na Europa, América Latina e América do Norte.
  • Vivência em indústrias reguladas como Serviços Financeiros, Saúde, Tecnologia, Varejo ou Telecom.
  • Certificações relevantes (por exemplo, CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, CRISC, CISA).

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

description:
Ei #fera, Líder Técnico (Java) chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 29 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:

  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary:


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Python to enable scalable, governed, and performant data solutions. You will play a key role in modernizing our data platform on the Azure Cloud, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:


·      Data Pipeline Development:  Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

·      Data Flows & Transformations:  Develop pipelines, data flows, and complex transformations with ADF, PySpark, and T-SQL for seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading.

·      Data Processing:  Develop Databricks Python notebooks for tasks such as joining, filtering, and pre-aggregation.

·      Database & Query Optimization:  Optimize database performance through SQL query tuning, index optimization, and code improvements to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

·      SSIS & Migration Support:  Maintain and enhance SSIS package design and deployment for legacy workloads; contribute to migration and modernization into cloud-native pipelines.

·      Collaboration & DevOps:  Work with cross-functional teams using Git (Azure Repos) for version control and Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for deployment.

·      Data Governance & Security : Partner with governance teams to integrate Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog for cataloging, lineage tracking, and role-based security.

·      API & External Integration:  Implement REST APIs to retrieve analytics data from diverse external data feeds, enhancing accessibility and interoperability.

·      Automation:  Automate ETL processes and database maintenance tasks using SQL Agent Jobs, ensuring data integrity and operational reliability.

·      Advanced SQL Expertise:  Craft and optimize complex T-SQL queries to support efficient data processing and analytical workloads.


Required Califications:


·       5+ years of hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.

·      5+ years of proven experience with Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and monitoring pipelines.

·      Strong SQL Server / T-SQL experience with a focus on query optimization, indexing strategies, and coding best practices.

·      Demonstrated experience in SSIS package design, deployment, and performance tuning.

·      Hands-on knowledge of Unity Catalog for governance.

·      Experience with Git (Azure DevOps Repos) and CI/CD practices in data engineering projects.


Nice to Have:


·       Exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC), Change Data Feed (CDF), and Temporal Tables.

·      Experience with Microsoft Purview, Power BI, and Azure-native integrations.

·      Familiarity with Profisee Master Data Management (MDM).

·      Working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications:


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced Azure certification

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional

  • Additional Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications demonstrating advanced database and cloud expertise

title: Video copywriter and editor (Facebook ads)
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Podcast Audio Editor
description:
Company Description

Sofia Health® is an online marketplace that connects clients with providers across a wide range of health and wellness services, offering everything from 1:1 sessions to wellness products. The platform empowers individuals to access both conventional and complementary care in one convenient location, giving them greater choice and control over their health journey. Providers can grow their practices by offering a variety of services and programs through Sofia Health. The company also partners with employers and government agencies, including VA Health Care Systems, to deliver accessible, integrative wellness programs. Sofia Health is dedicated to making wellness personalized, effective, and universally accessible.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Podcast Audio Editor. The Podcast Audio Editor will be responsible for editing podcast audio files, enhancing sound quality, implementing sound design, adding music, and ensuring overall quality control for each episode. The role involves working closely with the content team to maintain brand consistency and meet deadlines efficiently.


Responsibilities
  • Edit raw podcast audio into polished, broadcast-ready episodes
  • Remove filler words, false starts, redundancies, and off-topic tangents
  • Improve pacing, clarity, and flow without changing the speaker’s voice or intent
  • Restructure sections when needed based on how questions were answered
  • Insert intro/outro, sponsor reads, disclaimers, or updates when required
  • Follow embedded audio notes and written instructions carefully
  • Deliver clean final WAV/MP3 files on deadline
  • Produce 3–4 short clips per episode for marketing use
  • Support up to two rounds of edits per episode when requested


What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience editing long-form podcasts (interview or narrative style)
  • Strong editorial judgment — you know what to cut and why
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely
  • Comfortable working with physician and expert-level conversations
  • Fast, reliable turnaround times
  • Clear, professional communication
  • Familiarity with tools like Descript, Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Logic, or similar



Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Audio Editing, including cleaning, trimming, and fine-tuning audio files
  • Experience with Sound Design and the ability to enhance audio with effects and background elements
  • Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content
  • Strong Editing skills paired with attention to detail to maintain high-quality output
  • Familiarity with audio editing software such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar tools
  • Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with teams, and meet deadlines
  • Experience in podcast production is a plus
  • Background in audio engineering, media production, or a related field is beneficial

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade
description:
Estamos à procura de um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, para se juntar ao nosso time de profissionais excepcionais na RÓDIO TECH.


Buscamos um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, com sólida experiência em engenharia de confiabilidade, monitoramento de ambientes distribuídos e gestão de incidentes críticos. Um(a) profissional com domínio técnico em ferramentas como Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace, e com profundo conhecimento em práticas modernas de observabilidade, rastreamento distribuído e automação de alertas. Esperamos alguém que atue de forma estratégica, proponha padrões técnicos, eleve a maturidade dos nossos sistemas e dissemine boas práticas de visibilidade, performance e resiliência em toda a organização. O candidato ideal é colaborativo, analítico, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de dono, sempre alinhado aos valores e à visão da empresa.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:


Como Especialista SRE, essa pessoa será protagonista na evolução da plataforma de observabilidade da Empresa. Trará valor ao consolidar métricas, logs e rastreamentos em soluções robustas, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real, diagnóstico preciso de falhas e resposta eficiente a incidentes. Sua atuação será decisiva para o aumento da confiabilidade dos serviços, redução de indisponibilidades, melhoria contínua da performance e apoio estratégico às áreas de tecnologia e produto. Com sua expertise, teremos uma operação mais preditiva, escalável e resiliente. 


• Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.

• Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.

• Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.

• Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.

• Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.

• Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.

• Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.

• Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.

• Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes.


Principais conhecimentos:

• Observabilidade ponta a ponta com Zabbix, Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) e Dynatrace.

• Criação, padronização e manutenção de dashboards operacionais, executivos e técnicos.

• Implementação e monitoramento de SLIs, SLOs e SLAs alinhados a objetivos de negócio.

• Rastreamento distribuído (Distributed Tracing) com Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger ou similares.

• Monitoramento de ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e conteinerizados (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Integração com ferramentas de alerta e resposta a incidentes: Opsgenie, PagerDuty, VictorOps.

• Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).

• Participação ativa em war rooms, execução de post-mortems e condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis).

• Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).

• Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade.


Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.

• Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.

• Vivência com rastreamento distribuído e integração de logs/métricas em pipelines CI/CD.

• Capacidade de correlacionar dados de observabilidade com impacto no negócio.

• Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes).

• Fluência em automação com linguagens como Python, Shell Script, Go ou similares.

• Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com múltiplas áreas.

• Visão sistêmica, senso crítico e iniciativa para liderar projetos de melhoria contínua. Qualificações Desejáveis:

• Certificações em observabilidade e confiabilidade: Dynatrace Associate, Zabbix Certified, Elastic Observability, SRE Foundation.

• Conhecimento em Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e OpenTelemetry.

• Experiência com Chaos Engineering e validação de resiliência.

• Participação em incidentes críticos com liderança técnica na resposta.

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e desafios de visibilidade em ambientes distribuídos.

• Experiência com automação de runbooks e fluxos de resposta a incidentes.

• Familiaridade com práticas de FinOps e eficiência operacional em observabilidade.

• Participação em comunidades técnicas de SRE, DevOps e observabilidade.

• Contribuições para ferramentas ou boas práticas open source.

• Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e participação em fóruns internacionais. 


Modelo de contratação:


  • Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)


Modelo de atuação:


  • Modelo: 100% Remoto


Na RÓDIO TECH, conectamos os melhores profissionais às melhores vagas. Se você se identifica com esse perfil e busca uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa que valoriza o talento e a inovação, inscreva-se agora mesmo!

title: Podcast Audio Editor
description:
Company Description

Sofia Health® is an online marketplace that connects clients with providers across a wide range of health and wellness services, offering everything from 1:1 sessions to wellness products. The platform empowers individuals to access both conventional and complementary care in one convenient location, giving them greater choice and control over their health journey. Providers can grow their practices by offering a variety of services and programs through Sofia Health. The company also partners with employers and government agencies, including VA Health Care Systems, to deliver accessible, integrative wellness programs. Sofia Health is dedicated to making wellness personalized, effective, and universally accessible.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Podcast Audio Editor. The Podcast Audio Editor will be responsible for editing podcast audio files, enhancing sound quality, implementing sound design, adding music, and ensuring overall quality control for each episode. The role involves working closely with the content team to maintain brand consistency and meet deadlines efficiently.


Responsibilities
  • Edit raw podcast audio into polished, broadcast-ready episodes

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content

  • Familiarity with audio editing software such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar tools
  • Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with teams, and meet deadlines
  • Experience in podcast production is a plus
