title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Senior ABAP Cloud Developer (RAP & BTP Focus)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Reports to: CTO


Who We Are


COMO Digital Life is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg, building next-generation financial infrastructure for global businesses. We blend cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and elegant engineering to deliver secure, reliable payment solutions.

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject "Senior ABAP Cloud Developer". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst
description:
Job Description: Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst


About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst to guide research-driven decision-making for enterprise marketing website projects. This is not a product UX role — it’s a strategic position focused on user insight, information architecture, content strategy, and low-fidelity wireframing for B2B website design specifically.

You will run discovery activities, analyze user behavior, shape content and navigation strategy, and translate research into clear wireframes and recommendations. You’ll also lead client conversations and present UX rationale with confidence and clarity. This is a freelance contract position with consistent, ongoing project work.


Responsibilities

UX Research & Analysis

  • Plan and lead UX research activities (qualitative + quantitative) tailored to marketing/enterprise sites
  • Analyze user behavior, testing outputs, and analytics data (GA, Hotjar, Helio, etc.)
  • Identify friction points and conversion blockers across user journeys
  • Conduct competitive and comparative audits to inform structure and content direction
  • Synthesize insights into clear, prioritized, actionable UX recommendations


Information Architecture & Content Strategy

  • Audit existing website structures and perform detailed site map analysis
  • Develop and present site map recommendations that improve clarity, SEO alignment, and user flow
  • Create navigation models, content hierarchies, and IA documentation
  • Map user journeys and define key conversion paths
  • Build content frameworks and messaging priorities for enterprise web builds
  • Evaluate existing content for gaps, redundancy, clarity, and strategic alignment


Wireframing & Concepting

  • Translate IA and strategy decisions into low-fidelity wireframes
  • Produce clear UX documentation (flows, diagrams, wireframes, rationale)
  • Collaborate closely with designers to ensure strategic alignment through execution


Client Leadership

  • Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and UX debriefs
  • Present research findings and guide stakeholders toward best-practice decisions
  • Communicate fluently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing
  • Build trust through structured thinking, preparedness, and strong strategic reasoning



Requirements

  • 5–6+ years of experience in UX research, UX strategy, IA, or content design for websites
  • Deep understanding of enterprise marketing sites (not product UX)
  • Proven ability to plan, execute, and analyze UX research
  • Strong command of information architecture and content strategy
  • Ability to design clear, low-fi wireframes that translate strategy into structure
  • Excellent English communication skills and confidence leading client conversations
  • Ability to work independently across multiple projects
  • Proficiency with Figma, Helio, UserBrain, Hotjar, PostHog, Google Analytics, or equivalent tools


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience
  • CRO or SEO fluency
  • Familiarity with Webflow CMS structures
  • Experience with enterprise clients and multi-stakeholder environments


Contract Details

  • Freelance contract position
  • Remote, flexible hours
  • Must be available for client meetings within EU/US time zones

title: Senior ABAP Cloud Developer (RAP & BTP Focus)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Reports to: CTO


Who We Are


COMO Digital Life is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg, building next-generation financial infrastructure for global businesses. We blend cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and elegant engineering to deliver secure, reliable payment solutions.

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject "Senior ABAP Cloud Developer". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst
description:
Job Description: Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst


About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead UX Strategist & Research Analyst to guide research-driven decision-making for enterprise marketing website projects. This is not a product UX role — it’s a strategic position focused on user insight, information architecture, content strategy, and low-fidelity wireframing for B2B website design specifically.

You will run discovery activities, analyze user behavior, shape content and navigation strategy, and translate research into clear wireframes and recommendations. You’ll also lead client conversations and present UX rationale with confidence and clarity. This is a freelance contract position with consistent, ongoing project work.


Responsibilities

UX Research & Analysis

  • Plan and lead UX research activities (qualitative + quantitative) tailored to marketing/enterprise sites
  • Analyze user behavior, testing outputs, and analytics data (GA, Hotjar, Helio, etc.)
  • Identify friction points and conversion blockers across user journeys
  • Conduct competitive and comparative audits to inform structure and content direction
  • Synthesize insights into clear, prioritized, actionable UX recommendations


Information Architecture & Content Strategy

  • Audit existing website structures and perform detailed site map analysis
  • Develop and present site map recommendations that improve clarity, SEO alignment, and user flow
  • Create navigation models, content hierarchies, and IA documentation
  • Map user journeys and define key conversion paths
  • Build content frameworks and messaging priorities for enterprise web builds
  • Evaluate existing content for gaps, redundancy, clarity, and strategic alignment


Wireframing & Concepting

  • Translate IA and strategy decisions into low-fidelity wireframes
  • Produce clear UX documentation (flows, diagrams, wireframes, rationale)
  • Collaborate closely with designers to ensure strategic alignment through execution


Client Leadership

  • Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and UX debriefs
  • Present research findings and guide stakeholders toward best-practice decisions
  • Communicate fluently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing
  • Build trust through structured thinking, preparedness, and strong strategic reasoning



Requirements

  • 5–6+ years of experience in UX research, UX strategy, IA, or content design for websites
  • Deep understanding of enterprise marketing sites (not product UX)
  • Proven ability to plan, execute, and analyze UX research
  • Strong command of information architecture and content strategy
  • Ability to design clear, low-fi wireframes that translate strategy into structure
  • Excellent English communication skills and confidence leading client conversations
  • Ability to work independently across multiple projects
  • Proficiency with Figma, Helio, UserBrain, Hotjar, PostHog, Google Analytics, or equivalent tools


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience
  • CRO or SEO fluency
  • Familiarity with Webflow CMS structures
  • Experience with enterprise clients and multi-stakeholder environments


Contract Details

  • Freelance contract position
  • Remote, flexible hours
  • Must be available for client meetings within EU/US time zones

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly capable and experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to join their team. This role is ideal for a senior-level engineer who thrives on owning features end-to-end, from database schema design to frontend UI implementation.


This is a critical role that requires a solid grasp of modern, decoupled architecture and the ability to work effectively across the entire stack.


Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Development:  Design, build, and deploy new features and services across their product suite, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
  • Backend Engineering:  Develop and maintain core backend services using GoLang, implement efficient and scalable APIs using GraphQL, and manage their relational data infrastructure on Postgres.
  • Frontend Development:  Build intuitive, performant, and engaging user interfaces using Angular and Typescript, specifically focusing on internal dashboards, content management tools, and data visualization applications.
  • Cloud Infrastructure:  Utilize GCP (Google Cloud Platform) services to deploy, monitor, and scale their applications (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL).
  • Architectural Contributions:  Collaborate with the team on architectural decisions, ensuring their systems are secure, maintainable, and designed for long-term scalability.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience:  6-10 years of professional software development experience, ideally in a full-stack capacity.
  • Backend Expertise:  Strong proficiency with GoLang (Go) for developing performant microservices and APIs.
  • Database : Deep experience with Postgres (PostgreSQL), including advanced SQL, performance tuning, and database schema design.
  • Frontend Mastery:  Proven experience with JavaScript frameworks and Typescript to build complex, enterprise-grade web applications. Angular proficiency is preferred; otherwise, willingness to learn it is a must.
  • API Design:  Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs, with a preference for GraphQL.
  • Cloud Platform:  Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or another major cloud provider.


Preferred (Bonus Points):

  • Startup/Early Stage Experience:  Previous experience working in a small, fast-paced environment (e.g., on a team of 1-2 engineers), where independent problem-solving and wearing multiple hats were essential.
  • Media or Retail Tech:  Familiarity with concepts in AdTech, digital signage, content delivery networks (CDNs), or retail/CPG data environments.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge company revolutionizing in-store digital media and data-driven storytelling.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Role Overview:


We are looking for a highly experienced Business Systems Administrator who will serve as the primary owner and subject-matter expert for our ERP system. This individual will be fully responsible for the configuration, accuracy, day-to-day operation, and optimization of Epicor P21 across sales, inventory, purchasing, and reporting, with additional support for light accounting and bookkeeping functions. EXPERIENCE WITH EPICOR PROPHET 21 IS A MUST.


This role requires deep, hands-on P21 expertise in a wholesale or distribution environment and the ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.


Location: Remote

Role: Full-Time

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Rate: $8/hour


Core Responsibilities:


Epicor P21 Ownership (Primary Responsibility)

• Act as the system owner and P21 subject-matter expert

• Configure, maintain, and optimize Epicor P21 to support business operations

• Own end-to-end workflows including:

• Quotes, sales orders, invoicing, credits

• Purchasing, receiving, and vendor management

• Inventory management across one or more warehouses

• Manage customer pricing structures, contracts, and margin controls

• Monitor system accuracy, data integrity, and performance

• Identify and resolve system issues, errors, and inefficiencies

• Serve as the main point of contact with Epicor support and external consultants

• Create and maintain SOPs and internal documentation for P21 processes


Inventory, Sales & Purchasing Operations

• Ensure accurate inventory levels, replenishment, and demand planning

• Oversee backorders, partial shipments, and fulfillment workflows

• Support sales and operations teams with system guidance and reporting

• Track KPIs including sales, margins, inventory turns, and order accuracy


Reporting & Data Management

• Build and maintain standard and custom P21 reports

• Deliver recurring and ad-hoc reports for leadership

• Ensure reporting accuracy for operational and financial decision-making


Light Accounting & Bookkeeping Support

• Support AR and AP workflows within P21

• Assist with invoicing, payment tracking, and PO-to-invoice matching

• Perform basic reconciliations and data reviews

• Support month-end close preparation and coordination with accountants


Required Qualifications

• Advanced, hands-on experience with Epicor Prophet 21 (P21)

• Proven experience acting as a P21 administrator or system owner

• Strong background in wholesale / distribution operations

• Deep understanding of:

• Inventory management and purchasing workflows

• Complex pricing structures and margin controls

• ERP-driven order-to-cash processes

• Experience supporting accounting functions (AR/AP, invoicing, reconciliations)

• Ability to work independently and take full ownership of systems

• Strong problem-solving and documentation skills

• Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with multi-warehouse or high-SKU environments

• ERP implementation, migration, or optimization experience

• Familiarity with U.S. accounting processes

• Experience training users on Epicor P21


What Success Looks Like

• Epicor P21 operates accurately and efficiently with minimal rs

• Inventory, sales, and purchasing data are consistently reliable

• Leadership has clear, timely reporting for decision-making

• The business relies on this role as the go-to expert for P21

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.


A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Customer Success que queira ir além do atendimento e atue como uma verdadeira parceira estratégica dos nossos clientes. Alguém que construa relações de confiança, entenda profundamente os desafios e objetivos de cada cliente e os ajude a transformar nossas soluções em resultados concretos e duradouros. Essa pessoa será protagonista da jornada do cliente, combinando empatia, visão analítica e mentalidade orientada a valor para identificar oportunidades, antecipar necessidades e impulsionar o sucesso de cada conta. Aqui, Customer Success é sobre impacto real na jornada de crédito, recebimento e cobrança no agro, reflexo de crescimento conjunto e experiências memoráveis.



Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na gestão da carteira de clientes, assegurando engajamento, satisfação e sucesso na utilização dos serviços/produtos;
  • Realizar reuniões de onboarding, acompanhamento e alinhamentos periódicos (QBR, NPS, etc.);
  • Ser a voz do cliente internamente, identificando pontos de melhoria e repassando feedbacks para times internos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, expansão de receita e saúde da conta;
  • Antecipar riscos e agir proativamente para garantir renovação dos contratos;
  • Construir relacionamento consultivo, identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell;
  • Apoiar o cliente no planejamento e execução das melhores práticas de uso da plataforma/serviço;
  • Registrar informações e interações em sistemas internos (CRM).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente, Atendimento ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura consultiva;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de dados e tomada de decisões;
  • Organização, autonomia e habilidade para gerir múltiplas contas simultaneamente;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM (ex: HubSpot, RD Station, etc.);
  • Perfil orientado a resultados e solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto e bases fundiárias, com capacidade de interpretar mapas, croquis e informações georreferenciadas;
  • Experiência prévia nas áreas de crédito e/ou cobrança, compreendendo fluxos operacionais, análise de risco e acompanhamento de carteiras;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint, com facilidade para manipulação de dados, geração de relatórios e construção de apresentações
  • Perfil proativo e orientado a desafios, capaz de lidar bem com demandas dinâmicas, encontrar soluções práticas e transformar obstáculos em oportunidades.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, startups ou ambiente de alta performance;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de CS (Health Score, Sucesso do Cliente, Playbooks).

  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor – PeopleSoft CRM PS8 / Java
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista Desenvolvedor(a) para atuar na manutenção e sustentação de um ecossistema PeopleSoft CRM PS8 , altamente customizado ao longo dos anos em um grande cliente.

O PeopleSoft PS8 não passará por grandes evoluções funcionais , porém é crítico para o negócio, exigindo manutenções corretivas frequentes , além de manutenções evolutivas pontuais , principalmente para atendimento a exigências regulatórias .

Além do PS8, o ambiente contempla:


  • Portlets acoplados ao PeopleSoft , utilizados como forma de personalização e extensão funcional;
  • Uma camada de integração SOA , responsável pela comunicação com diversos sistemas legados;
  • Procedures, jobs e rotinas PL/SQL que suportam o funcionamento do ecossistema;
  • Demandas complementares em Java , permitindo o aproveitamento do profissional em outras frentes técnicas quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na manutenção corretiva do PeopleSoft CRM PS8 , analisando, diagnosticando e corrigindo falhas em produção;
  • Realizar manutenções evolutivas pontuais , principalmente relacionadas a demandas regulatórias;
  • Analisar, manter e dar suporte a customizações do PeopleSoft , incluindo PeopleCode, componentes e configurações do PeopleTools;
  • Atuar na sustentação e manutenção de portlets integrados ao PS8 , utilizados para personalizações específicas do cliente;
  • Analisar e apoiar a sustentação da camada de integração SOA , garantindo a correta troca de dados com sistemas legados;
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar procedures, triggers e jobs PL/SQL associados ao ecossistema;
  • Apoiar a equipe na análise de incidentes e problemas em ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção;
  • Contribuir com análises de performance , ajustes de código e melhorias de estabilidade;
  • Utilizar conhecimentos em Java para atender demandas complementares (APIs, serviços auxiliares, integrações, ferramentas internas ou apoio a outras squads).


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência prática com PeopleSoft CRM PS8 , especialmente em ambientes fortemente customizados;
  • Conhecimento sólido em PeopleTools / PeopleCode e componentes do PeopleSoft;
  • Experiência com Integration Broker , web services SOAP/REST , XML e JSON;
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle e PL/SQL (procedures, queries, jobs);
  • Vivência com integrações SOA e comunicação entre sistemas legados;
  • Experiência com manutenção corretiva e suporte a sistemas críticos em produção;
  • Conhecimento em Java , com capacidade de atuar em demandas backend ou de integração;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica , diagnóstico e resolução de problemas complexos.


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Conhecimento em PeopleSoft Query e SQR;
  • Vivência com portlets ou frameworks de customização web;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Familiaridade com versionamento de código e práticas de DevOps / CI-CD;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de monitoramento e observabilidade de aplicações.

  • Atuar na sustentação e manutenção de portlets integrados ao PS8 , utilizados para personalizações específicas do cliente;

title: Tech Lead .NET Core
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56624


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.
  • Domínio de React.js , Hooks , Context API , e boas práticas de componentização.
  • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)


  • Arquitetura:
  • Experiência comprovada com microserviços e event-driven architecture .
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiencia com integração com sistemas


  • Cloud (AWS):
  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly capable and experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to join their team. This role is ideal for a senior-level engineer who thrives on owning features end-to-end, from database schema design to frontend UI implementation.


This is a critical role that requires a solid grasp of modern, decoupled architecture and the ability to work effectively across the entire stack.


Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Development:  Design, build, and deploy new features and services across their product suite, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
  • Backend Engineering:  Develop and maintain core backend services using GoLang, implement efficient and scalable APIs using GraphQL, and manage their relational data infrastructure on Postgres.
  • Frontend Development:  Build intuitive, performant, and engaging user interfaces using Angular and Typescript, specifically focusing on internal dashboards, content management tools, and data visualization applications.
  • Cloud Infrastructure:  Utilize GCP (Google Cloud Platform) services to deploy, monitor, and scale their applications (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL).
  • Architectural Contributions:  Collaborate with the team on architectural decisions, ensuring their systems are secure, maintainable, and designed for long-term scalability.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience:  6-10 years of professional software development experience, ideally in a full-stack capacity.
  • Backend Expertise:  Strong proficiency with GoLang (Go) for developing performant microservices and APIs.
  • Database : Deep experience with Postgres (PostgreSQL), including advanced SQL, performance tuning, and database schema design.
  • Frontend Mastery:  Proven experience with JavaScript frameworks and Typescript to build complex, enterprise-grade web applications. Angular proficiency is preferred; otherwise, willingness to learn it is a must.
  • API Design:  Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs, with a preference for GraphQL.
  • Cloud Platform:  Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or another major cloud provider.


Preferred (Bonus Points):

  • Startup/Early Stage Experience:  Previous experience working in a small, fast-paced environment (e.g., on a team of 1-2 engineers), where independent problem-solving and wearing multiple hats were essential.
  • Media or Retail Tech:  Familiarity with concepts in AdTech, digital signage, content delivery networks (CDNs), or retail/CPG data environments.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge company revolutionizing in-store digital media and data-driven storytelling.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Role Overview:


We are looking for a highly experienced Business Systems Administrator who will serve as the primary owner and subject-matter expert for our ERP system. This individual will be fully responsible for the configuration, accuracy, day-to-day operation, and optimization of Epicor P21 across sales, inventory, purchasing, and reporting, with additional support for light accounting and bookkeeping functions. EXPERIENCE WITH EPICOR PROPHET 21 IS A MUST.


This role requires deep, hands-on P21 expertise in a wholesale or distribution environment and the ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.


Location: Remote

Role: Full-Time

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Rate: $8/hour


Core Responsibilities:


Epicor P21 Ownership (Primary Responsibility)

• Act as the system owner and P21 subject-matter expert

• Configure, maintain, and optimize Epicor P21 to support business operations

• Own end-to-end workflows including:

• Quotes, sales orders, invoicing, credits

• Purchasing, receiving, and vendor management

• Inventory management across one or more warehouses

• Manage customer pricing structures, contracts, and margin controls

• Monitor system accuracy, data integrity, and performance

• Identify and resolve system issues, errors, and inefficiencies

• Serve as the main point of contact with Epicor support and external consultants

• Create and maintain SOPs and internal documentation for P21 processes


Inventory, Sales & Purchasing Operations

• Ensure accurate inventory levels, replenishment, and demand planning

• Oversee backorders, partial shipments, and fulfillment workflows

• Support sales and operations teams with system guidance and reporting

• Track KPIs including sales, margins, inventory turns, and order accuracy


Reporting & Data Management

• Build and maintain standard and custom P21 reports

• Deliver recurring and ad-hoc reports for leadership

• Ensure reporting accuracy for operational and financial decision-making


Light Accounting & Bookkeeping Support

• Support AR and AP workflows within P21

• Assist with invoicing, payment tracking, and PO-to-invoice matching

• Perform basic reconciliations and data reviews

• Support month-end close preparation and coordination with accountants


Required Qualifications

• Advanced, hands-on experience with Epicor Prophet 21 (P21)

• Proven experience acting as a P21 administrator or system owner

• Strong background in wholesale / distribution operations

• Deep understanding of:

• Inventory management and purchasing workflows

• Complex pricing structures and margin controls

• ERP-driven order-to-cash processes

• Experience supporting accounting functions (AR/AP, invoicing, reconciliations)

• Ability to work independently and take full ownership of systems

• Strong problem-solving and documentation skills

• Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with multi-warehouse or high-SKU environments

• ERP implementation, migration, or optimization experience

• Familiarity with U.S. accounting processes

• Experience training users on Epicor P21


What Success Looks Like

• Epicor P21 operates accurately and efficiently with minimal rs

• Inventory, sales, and purchasing data are consistently reliable

• Leadership has clear, timely reporting for decision-making

• The business relies on this role as the go-to expert for P21

title: Senior ABAP Cloud Developer (RAP & BTP Focus)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Reports to: CTO


Who We Are


COMO Digital Life is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg, building next-generation financial infrastructure for global businesses. We blend cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and elegant engineering to deliver secure, reliable payment solutions.

We're looking for a Senior ABAP Cloud Developer who understands that the future of SAP is not in modifying standard code, but in building robust, cloud-native extensions using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), CDS Views, and SAP BTP. If you're ready to leave SE80 behind and embrace Eclipse/ADT, clean core architecture, and API-first development, you'll fit right in.


Your Mission


Your mission is to architect and deliver modern SAP solutions that power our financial operations, payment flows, and compliance reporting. You will champion the Clean Core approach, building upgrade-safe extensions that leverage SAP's latest cloud technologies.

Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and intelligence of COMO's financial ecosystem—using ABAP RAP for transactional processing, CDS Views for high-performance data modeling, and SAP HANA for database-level optimization. You'll also leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.


What You'll Do


  • Design and develop end-to-end applications using the ABAP RAP model (Managed and Unmanaged scenarios), including behavior definitions, validations, determinations, and actions.
  • Build and optimize CDS View Entities across interface, projection, and consumption layers with proper annotations and authorization via DCL.
  • Architect solutions that strictly adhere to Clean Core principles, utilizing released APIs, side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP, and Key User Extensibility to keep systems upgrade-safe.
  • Develop high-performance data processing using SQLScript and AMDP, pushing logic to the SAP HANA database layer where appropriate.
  • Expose and consume OData services (V2 and V4), integrating SAP with external fintech platforms using SAP Integration Suite.
  • Conduct code reviews, enforce static code analysis (ATC), and write ABAP Unit tests to ensure financial-grade reliability and security.
  • Apply AI tools in development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and optimization.
  • Mentor mid-level developers in the transition from classical ABAP to modern ABAP OO and Cloud methodologies.


What You Bring


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience with deep expertise in ABAP Objects (OO design, interfaces, exceptions, clean code practices).
  • Proven hands-on experience with ABAP RAP (Behavior Definitions, Service Bindings, EML, transactional processing).
  • Expert-level knowledge of CDS Views including associations, annotations, and layered view design.
  • Experience with SAP BTP for building extensions and services that support clean core architecture.
  • Strong SAP HANA knowledge: SQLScript, AMDP, performance optimization, and database-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with OData V2 and V4 service development and consumption.
  • Proficiency with Eclipse ADT (ABAP Development Tools) and Git-based version control (abapGit).
  • Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and international collaboration.


Nice to Have


  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • SAP Fiori development experience (Fiori Elements, UI5, UI annotations strategy).
  • Knowledge of SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming) model for polyglot development.
  • Experience with BTP services: Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Workflow Management, or Build Process Automation.
  • Fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction environment background.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and practices.


Why Join Us?


  • Work on modern SAP engineering (RAP, CDS, BTP) instead of legacy-heavy maintenance—this is your career pivot into the future of SAP.
  • Build solutions for a regulated fintech where engineering quality, security, and reliability are first-class priorities.
  • True remote work from anywhere in Brazil with international exposure and meaningful ownership of cloud-ready SAP architectures.
  • Influence key automation, reporting, and integration initiatives in a tech-first culture.
  • Continuous learning support for certifications and training to keep you at the bleeding edge of the SAP roadmap.


How to Apply


Send your CV in English to with the subject "Senior ABAP Cloud Developer". Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.


Recruitment Process


1.      Screening Teams interview with HR (15 min).

2.      Technical conversation with our CTO (30-45 mins) to discuss your experience with RAP, CDS, and modern ABAP practices.


Ready to Join Us?


If you're excited about building cloud-native SAP solutions using RAP and CDS, enjoy solving complex architectural challenges with clean core principles, and want to contribute to a modern fintech leveraging AI and automation at its core - this role is for you.


We look forward to meeting engineers who value clean architecture, upgrade-safe extensibility, and high-quality code.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)

The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management.   • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
